id.description: Unique identifier for the switch input

name.description: Name attribute for the switch input, used for form submission

value.description: Value attribute for the switch input

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name when a visible label is unsuitable.

description.description: Optional description text that provides additional information about the switch

tile.description: Whether to use the tile switch style

small.description: Whether to use the compact switch style

error.description: Error message to display when the switch is in an error state

success.description: Success message to display when the switch is in a success state

formGroup.description: Wrap the switch and its message in a form group. Set false inside another form group.

color.description: Color of the checked track, applied as before-{color} on the label. Defaults to primary.

className.description: Additional classes on the switch container.

onChange.description: Function called when the switch value changes (React) or JavaScript code string for onchange attribute (Django)

required.description: Whether the switch is required, adds asterisk to label and required attribute to input
